# Vendored dependency

This directory contains the runtime source files from `github.com/skip2/go-qrcode` commit `da1b6568686e89143e94f980a98bc2dbd5537f13`.

It is vendored so the AHA2 core can render the short-lived Feishu Device Authorization URL as a local PNG without sending that URL to a third-party QR service. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE`; tests and repository metadata are omitted.
